prompt: Create a new stained-glass puzzle design sheet of a goldfish with a flowing tail, titled only in metadata Japon Balığı: NO text in image. Attached fox is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for elegant leaded-panel craftsmanship and smooth meaningful contours, NOT its complexity or subject. Portrait 3:4 canvas, opaque pure white exterior. One large centred vertical OVAL panel nearly touching all canvas edges, thick closed black rim without decorative border ring. A graceful goldfish swims diagonally upward left, rounded body with elegant large flowing tail curling downward right, clearly recognisable fins. Crucial: only 12–22 closed panes TOTAL, aim 18: about 8 large fish pieces including one visible round eye pane and 10 broad calm water pieces. No scales, bubbles, plants, fin rays or extra decoration. Exactly four FLAT solid glass colours: vermilion orange #E86B20 and golden yellow #F2C443 ONLY on fish, turquoise #42AEC5 and deep teal #176D70 ONLY on water. Alternate orange and yellow fish pieces; alternate turquoise and deep teal neighbouring water pieces. Eye is a small gold-coloured closed pane within orange head, no black dot pupil. Use large smooth outline-to-outline body/tail divisions that permit pair alternation. Background broad flowing water partitions connect fish outline to outer rim with staggered joins, not concentric rings or a chain of horizontal bands. Most panes touch at least three others. Every line connects boundary or junction to boundary or junction, no loose lines. Uniform pure black lead about 1% canvas width. ONLY separated T junctions with at least 3% panel width between joins, never X or four-way meetings, no pinched narrow slivers or tiny fragments. Natural refined stained-glass design, not cartoon, no smiling face. Flat fills for tracing, no gradients, shading, reflections, glass texture or highlights. Before finishing count closed panes and keep total under 23.
